{{recipe}}| [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|Cuisine of the United States]]

==Ingredients==
*6 [[Cookbook:Sweet Potato|sweet potatoes]]
*½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Margarine|margarine]] 
*1 cup [[Cookbook:Brown Sugar|brown sugar]] 
*2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla extract]] 
*¼ cup [[Cookbook:Water|water]]

==Procedure==
#Preheat oven to [[cookbook:Oven temperatures|350 °F]] (175 °C).  
#[[Cookbook:Boil|Boil]] yams in skins until about half done. 
#Drain water from yams, remove skins, and cut in cubes.   
#Place yam cubes in a greased [[Cookbook:Baking Dish|baking dish]] and dot with margarine.   
#Make a [[Cookbook:Sugar syrup|syrup]] by boiling brown sugar, water, and vanilla together. Pour over the yams.
#[[cookbook:Bake|Bake]] for 45 to 50 minutes, [[Cookbook:Basting|basting]] frequently with syrup, until yams are tender.

''This recipe reuses material from the article [[w:Candied yams|Candied yams]] at [[w:Main page|Wikipedia]] under the GFDL.''
